confirmation.introductoryOffer: Your store reports this introductory offer: {{offer}}.
confirmation.premiumAppearsAfterVerification: Premium appears only after the Game Backend verifies the store transaction.
confirmation.upgradeBody: The App Store controls the final charge and effective date for this upgrade. Premium reflects {{label}} only after the Game Backend verifies it.
confirmation.planChangeBody: The App Store defers this change to the end of your current period: {{currentLabel}} keeps running until then, and {{targetLabel}} is billed from the change date. Cancel the change from Manage Subscription.
confirmation.balanceChangesAfterVerificationCoin: Your balance changes only after the Game Backend verifies the store transaction and records the matching Commerce Ledger grant.
confirmation.balanceChangesAfterVerificationAiCredit: Your balance changes only after the Game Backend verifies the store transaction and records the matching Commerce Ledger grant. Premium Membership is not required.

disclosure.subscriptionTerms: Payment is charged to your {{store}} account at confirmation. {{label}} Premium renews automatically at {{offer}} unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. You can cancel at any time from your {{store}} account.

guestDataRiskNotice.commerceBody: You can purchase without registration. Premium Membership can be restored from the store, but Stitch Coin, AI Credit, and private Guest content are unrecoverable if this installation is lost. Registering protects them and never interrupts playing as a Guest.
